messages:
Leah: heads up - noticed legend is overlapping the hover tooltip on the performance dashboard when axis labels are long (p95 latency (ms) / request rate). Screenshot attached: https://redwood.example/snap/legend-tooltip-overlap.png
Sam: ugh yeah. On narrow viewports the legend wraps and pushes into tooltip zone. What if we move legend to a collapsible drawer at the right? keeps canvas clean.
Diego: drawer seems heavy for small charts. alternative: floating legend (absolutely positioned) that reflows above the tooltip and can be pinned/unpinned.
Nia: accessibility + mobile concerns: drawers have clear focus traps; floating things need good keyboard targets. either approach ok if we handle focus order.
Leah: preference for floating legend with a small drag handle so teams can reposition. default position top-right. Pin state persisted per dashboard.
Sam: behavior questions: when user drags legend on redraw (new data), should it snap back? I think persist position but allow reset.
Diego: also want unit badges in legend items (tiny pill: ms, req/s, %) to reduce label noise on the axis. badge color = muted bg + 12px font.
Nia: unit badge accessibility nit: include full unit name in ARIA not just symbol, e.g., aria-label=\"p95 latency: 120 milliseconds\". Also ensure contrast ratio of badge text meets 4.5:1 if used as primary label.
Leah: spike handling: option to \"denoise\" series (light smoothing + outlier clamp) so users can compare baseline trends without bright spike markers. toggle in legend: Denote with small filter icon.
Sam: denote toggles state in legend via aria-pressed so screen readers pick it up.
Diego: implementation: server can return a denoiseable flag per series. client applies a gaussian smoothing kernel when enabled. example payload flag: `"denoise": true`.
Nia: microcopy suggestion for the denoise tooltip: \"Filter transient spikes to focus on baseline trends. Turning this on reduces marker intensity and applies light smoothing.\" keep it under 140 chars.
Leah: keyboard shortcuts proposal: Shift+L to open legend focus, Arrow keys to move pinned position when focused, D to toggle denoise. keep discoverability via a small ? help.
Sam: UX concern: when denoise is on, legend entries should show a tiny remainder badge if spikes were suppressed (e.g., +3 spikes hidden). helps users know we removed data.
Diego: good call. user testing idea: A/B test pinned drawer vs floating legend for time-to-action metrics.
Nia: accessibility checklist items: 1) focusable drag handle 2) aria-live update when legend moves 3) screen reader announcement for denoise state change 4) visible focus indicator for legend items.
Leah: action items: Diego -> prototype floating legend + denoise toggle, Sam -> spec keyboard interactions + persistence, Nia -> write accessibility checklist copy, Leah -> draft microcopy for badges and denoise tooltip. sync Fri 10am.
deploy-bot: Scheduled nightly build triggered: #build-frontend-472 will include legend layout changes (branch: feature/floating-legend).
